+# Axis Website Growth Audit
+
+> Axis provides free, personalized website audits for small businesses. Each AI-assisted, founder-reviewed audit evaluates messaging clarity, mobile usability, trust signals, SEO fundamentals, and conversion flow, then delivers prioritized recommendations and practical quick wins.
+
+Axis helps business owners identify what may be costing their website leads, understand which improvements matter most, and choose the smallest complete solution for their needs.
+
+## Start Here
+
+- [Request a Free Website Growth Audit](https://1oldguyinaz-glitch.github.io/axis-website-audit-repo/#audit-form): Submit a business website for a free personalized review.
+- [What the Website Audit Includes](https://1oldguyinaz-glitch.github.io/axis-website-audit-repo/#included): Review the website scorecard, conversion issues, quick wins, and fit-based recommendations.
+- [How the Audit Process Works](https://1oldguyinaz-glitch.github.io/axis-website-audit-repo/#process): Learn how Axis reviews a website and delivers a prioritized action plan.
+
+## Website Audit Topics
+
+- [Website Messaging and Clarity](https://1oldguyinaz-glitch.github.io/axis-website-audit-repo/#included): Evaluation of whether visitors quickly understand the business, offer, and next step.
+- [Website Conversion Optimization](https://1oldguyinaz-glitch.github.io/axis-website-audit-repo/#included): Identification of friction, weak calls to action, confusing navigation, and lost-lead opportunities.
+- [Mobile Website Usability](https://1oldguyinaz-glitch.github.io/axis-website-audit-repo/#included): Review of the mobile experience, readability, usability, and conversion path.
+- [Website Trust and Credibility](https://1oldguyinaz-glitch.github.io/axis-website-audit-repo/#included): Review of trust signals, professionalism, credibility, and visitor confidence.
+- [SEO Fundamentals](https://1oldguyinaz-glitch.github.io/axis-website-audit-repo/#included): Review of foundational search visibility, page structure, content clarity, and technical indicators.
+- [Website Strategy and Redesign Guidance](https://1oldguyinaz-glitch.github.io/axis-website-audit-repo/#about): Fit-based recommendations focused on the smallest complete solution.
+
+## About Axis
+
+- [Why Axis Exists](https://1oldguyinaz-glitch.github.io/axis-website-audit-repo/#about): Founder-led website strategy for small-business owners who need clear, practical, pressure-free guidance.
